Enrich person.name: Jonathan Fisher
Enrich person.title: Director of Premier Segment (COO Premier Banking)
Enrich person.summary:
Senior banking executive with 20 years driving enterprise-scale client experience transformation, data & analytics, and P&L performance across consumer and affluent banking. Currently COO of Truist's Premier & Branch Banking platform — $125B in deposits, 3.2M households — with direct ownership of business management, data & analytics, change governance, and strategic execution.

Previously architected a client engagement and segmentation strategy generating $1B+ in incremental revenue and 250K+ net new affluent households, operationalized end-to-end across digital, advisor, and channel touchpoints. Led merger integration and transformation across 3.5M clients, $120B in deposits, and $60B in loans during the largest U.S. bank merger in 30 years — preserving performance continuity while restructuring the operating model.

Areas of focus: P&L and operating model leadership, client experience strategy, data-driven transformation, and cross-functional program governance in highly regulated environments.

Open to conversations with organizations building durable, client-centered operating models — particularly where operational leadership, data-driven transformation, and client experience intersect.
Enrich person.headline: Banking COO | Strategy, Transformation & Client Experience

education.school_name: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

experience.title: Director of Premier Segment (COO Premier Banking)
experience.summary:
• COO accountable for enterprise business management, operating performance, data & analytics, and change execution across a consumer banking platform serving ~3.2M households.
• Own P&L performance and operating outcomes for a $125B deposit portfolio, including performance management, prioritization, and execution oversight.
• Established a cross-functional program office to govern delivery of near- and long-term strategic initiatives, ensuring execution discipline and leadership alignment.
• Led end-to-end redesign of client experience and referral pathways across digital, retail, wholesale, and wealth channels.

experience.title: Client Engagement & Strategy Director
experience.summary:
• Led an enterprise strategy, project, and business management team accountable for end-to-end delivery of a multi-year initiative, targeting $1B in incremental revenue. 
• Owned operating alignment across product, operations, data & insights, technology, finance, risk management, digital and strategic partnerships, ensuring coordinated execution and decision-making at scale.
• Established execution discipline and performance management routines to translate strategy into measurable outcomes across consumer banking channels. 
• Delivered the first two phases of the initiative driving 20% revenue growth, a 33% increase in new deposit production, and a 13% increase in credit card production validating the operating model.

experience.title: Consumer Banking Strategy Director
experience.summary:
• Promoted during a complex merger to lead acquisition and retention execution for an affluent segment, impacting 3.5M+ households and $120B+ in deposits while maintaining performance continuity.
• Owned end-to-end go-to-market execution for new client segments, aligning technology, marketing, and restructured sales teams across channels.
• Drove growth by translating short  and long term strategies into operating plans, execution priorities, and measurable performance outcomes.
• Led transformation of delivery channels and digital engagement to improve scalability, client experience, and segment specific effectiveness.

experience.title: Head of Strategic Initiatives
experience.summary:
• Led senior strategists delivering enterprise solutions impacting 1,300+ branches and 9,000+ teammates across 13 states.
• Directed cross-functional delivery of product enhancements, network optimization, and revenue growth initiatives at enterprise scale.
• Owned KPIs, financial reporting, and operating dashboards, driving transparency and leadership accountability.
• Led monthly business reviews with C suite leaders, highlighting results, risks, and execution priorities.

experience.title: Branch & Premier Banking Market Execution Leader
experience.summary:
• Spearheaded a team leading sales performance execution across 339 branches with over 2K teammates. 
• Managed the logistics of a $22.2B deposit portfolio, a $2.3B lending portfolio, and $303M in investment asset referrals. 
• Directed the senior leadership team and coached leaders on behavioral and financial results. Led a partnership forum that leveraged cross-functional referrals to drive performance.

experience.title: Mortgage Strategy Manager
